-- out --
package test

t1 input(items []string) {
	<div>
		{ "the" }
		<div>{ "other" }</div>
		switch items[0] {
			case "a":
				<div>{ items[0] }</div>
			case "b":
				<div>{ items[1] }</div>
		}
	</div>
}
